target_title: Target Job Title  |  Specialty or Top Credential
summary: Two to four sentences. Start with a noun phrase describing what you are, then the field and the scale you work at, then the tools you genuinely know, and close with one result that has a number in it. Third person, never "I". Write this last, after every other section exists.

bullets: Action verb + what you did + the tool or method + the result or scale.
Keep each one to a single line. Vary the length and the opening verb.
Do not force a number into every bullet. Two or three per role is human.
Present tense for the current role, past tense for every other one.
Action verb + what you did + the tool or method + the result or scale.
Two to three bullets is right for an older role.
One to two for anything more than ten years old.
One line, or none. Only on a career too long for the page budget.
What you built, the tools you used, who it served, and what it achieved.
One technical detail that shows depth, plus a number if you have one.
Two strong projects beat five weak ones. Cut any you cannot walk through.

sections._note_five_or_more: Past four certifications, drop entries and use the grouped form instead: "kind": "grouped" with "items": [["Category:", "Cert Name (Year), Cert Name (Year)"]]
